##### Project general facts

Gate Royale Residences is a residential development by Baron Development with a contemporary architectural design and a focus on comfortable everyday living. The collection includes one, two and three bedroom apartments alongside spacious three bedroom duplexes, with select homes opening onto private terraces and plunge pools. Balconies and terraces extend the living areas outdoors.

Residents enjoy a rooftop swimming pool, a dedicated kids' pool and a children's play area for families. A fully equipped gym, a landscaped outdoor lounge and a barbecue area create space for wellness and social gatherings. Smart access control, dedicated parking and round-the-clock surveillance complete the everyday experience.

Kitchens are delivered fully fitted with TEKA appliances. An integrated smart home system, climate control and high-speed internet connectivity add comfort and convenience to daily living.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is a well-established residential community in Dubai, combining quiet villa streets with modern apartment buildings. The neighbourhood offers convenient road access to Sheikh Zayed Road and to the coastal districts of Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence and Palm Jumeirah.

Discovery Gardens metro station on the Dubai Metro Red Line sits close by, and the community is well connected to Ibn Battuta Mall and Al Maktoum International Airport. Schools, clinics, supermarkets and places of worship of several faiths are located within the area, covering the daily needs of residents.

The community attracts steady rental demand from young professionals and families who value its central position and calmer pace. Property here is freehold and open to international buyers, positioned as a practical alternative to the busier waterfront districts nearby.
